## Source: amazon-inspector (20ee522ae4bca552485c294db9f0b73cb261f97f80379f2b7bde2a2f82d10ae3)
Package cobbleload version 0.1.0 on PyPI was scanned across 10 files with no a static rule matches and no traced behavioral findings. No install-time or import-time network activity, credential or environment reads, filesystem persistence, or lifecycle-script execution was identified. Nothing in the scanned contents indicates a supply-chain attack against installers.

## Source: kam193 (9cf9dcc227e75e864e1dffc62bc95b8d0f73dea45b088ed34ab718a8ab87fb08)
This campaign consists of similar loader packages, which provide executing code from a given URL. While they do not contain the malicious payload and the usage remains unknown, they are clearly a coordinated campaign to place multiple deceptive ways to load malicious code.
